_comment: Baseline of known/expected failures so the dashboard separates NEW regressions from already-tracked backend bugs. A smoke 'fail' whose key matches an entry here is shown as 'known-red' (muted), not a new regression. Type follows the ReportPortal taxonomy: Product Bug | Automation Bug | System Issue.
_stuck_comment: stuck_resources = documented, currently-undeletable OWNED leftovers. The /testing/resources owned-scan folds matching rows into a collapsed '기지 항목 (문서화된 잔존)' group instead of alarming. Remove an entry when the resource finally deletes.

PF-19 — PUT /v1/apis/{api_id}/resource-policies -> 500 ContactAdminForAssistance with the proven policy_document shape (run 27466988779, gen-wave5-apigw-policy). Previously thought VERIFIED; a write that worked before now 5xxes. Muted pending backend fix; the composed step tolerates 500 so the chain survives.

PF-23 — POST /v1/privatelink-endpoints -> 500 ContactAdminForAssistance. DOCS VERIFICATION (regression-agent 2026-06-18): the request body is CORRECT — privatelinkendpointcreaterequest model requires exactly {name (pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$, 3..20), privatelink_service_id (required), description (optional)} and the scenario sends precisely that shape (name 'regrple<ualpha>' = 15 lowercase chars, valid). A bad/non-existent privatelink_service_id MUST yield 400/404, not 500 — same ContactAdmin-class backend fault as budget createaccountbudget / apigateway setresourcepolicy (PF-19). NOT a body-shape bug we can fix; genuine product bug. Muted pending backend fix; the lifecycle's xcov-pl-create group tolerates the 5xx and records the CALL for coverage.

POST /v1/public-domain-names -> 500 InternalServerError / ContactAdminForAssistance (the failed create also surfaces in loggingaudit as a Create Error). Our request body is PROVEN CORRECT: it is byte-for-byte the documented createpublicdomainname/1.3 request_example and carries every required field of the createpublicdomainrequest model (data/api_docs.json) — address_type, name, all four domestic_*_address_*, the overseas_* trio, postal_code, register_email/name/telno. So this is NOT a malformed-body 4xx mis-surfacing as 500; it is a genuine backend fault, same ContactAdmin class as budget createaccountbudget / iam createrole / quick-query validate-resources. Public-domain create is also a REAL PAID DOMAIN REGISTRATION ORDER, so we do not retry-chain it. Tracked upstream, not a suite regression.

SCP backend 500 ContactAdminForAssistance on POST /v1/clusters for postgresql engine (live heavy-dbaas recovery run, fired twice). mysql/mariadb/epas/cachestore create OK with identical shared-VPC body shape -> postgresql-backend create fault, not a body/linking bug. Tracked upstream, not a regression in our suite.

SCP backend 500 ContactAdminForAssistance on POST /v1/clusters for mysql engine (run-892a; validated-facts 2026-07-11 재확인 — postgresql create-500과 동일 클래스). mariadb/epas/cachestore create OK with identical shared-VPC body shape -> mysql-backend create fault, not a body bug. 기존 mysql sub-op 베이스라인(upgradekernel 등)만 있고 create 항목이 누락되어 있었음.

GET /v1/backups/backup-targets?server_category=VIRTUAL_SERVER&policy_type=VM_IMAGE returns 500 ContactAdminForAssistance. Same for GPU_SERVER+VM_IMAGE. BAREMETAL_SERVER+VM_IMAGE returns 400 (correct: not supported). FILESYSTEM policy_type returns 200 for all server categories. Smoke.py default policy_type=VM_IMAGE is wrong for this endpoint — FILESYSTEM is safe. Backend bug in the VM_IMAGE+VIRTUAL_SERVER combination (confirmed 2026-06-20, no fix ETA).

PUT /v1/cloud-functions/{fn_id}/configurations/privatelink-endpoints/{endpoint_id}/approval -> 404 scp-cloud-function.privatelink-endpoint-not-found even when endpoint_id IS valid (returned by createprivatelinkendpoint and confirmed in listprivatelinkendpoint; the same endpoint_id works for /request and DELETE). Live-tested 2026-06-24 in HEAVY PL run: both fn1/fn2 had a REQUESTING-state PLE; approval via this endpoint always returns 404. Provider/consumer approval must instead go through VPC's PUT /v1/privatelink-endpoints/{id}/approval. SCF consumer-side approve endpoint is non-functional.

PUT /v1/cloud-functions/{fn_id}/configurations/privatelink-endpoints/{endpoint_id}/connection -> 404 scp-cloud-function.privatelink-endpoint-not-found even when endpoint_id IS valid. Same root cause as approveprivatelinkendpoint: SCF consumer-side connect endpoint is non-functional. Connection state changes (DISCONNECT/RECONNECT) must go through VPC's PUT /v1/privatelink-endpoints/{id}/connection. Live-tested 2026-06-24 in HEAVY PL run.

PrivateLink Service teardown DEADLOCK. SCF PLS can get permanently stuck in CREATING state (privatelink_service_id stays null for hours). PUT .../configurations/privatelink-services {privatelink_service_enabled:false} -> 400 scp-cloud-function.privatelink-service-not-allow-state-error ('deactivation not allowed when Creating state'). DELETE /v1/cloud-functions/{id} -> 400 scp-cloud-function.function-not-deletable-error ('Deleting allowed only when PrivateLink Service is disabled and PrivateLink Endpoint does not exist'). => stuck-CREATING PLS can neither be disabled nor force the function to delete: the function is un-teardownable via API. Live-confirmed 2026-06-24 HEAVY PL run on regrw5trg57f68be7 (9e231b01e2394d7aaa8dcca218e770cb) + regrw5trgd7ff680d (3aac2e34203a42cab56b089336bbd18d); both still stranded. Needs backend timeout of the CREATING state or console/support intervention.

401 Dbaas.Unauthorized.AuthNFailed with valid HMAC — backup-family asymmetry: setbackup POST on the SAME path/cluster/signing 2xx's across all engines while DELETE /backups + PUT /backup-histories 401. Console disables backup via the '백업 수정' modal's 사용 checkbox (set/modify plane), so the DELETE appears to have no console-equivalent path. Family spans mysql/mariadb/postgresql/epas/cachestore/searchengine (owner screenshots 2026-07-18). Pending discriminator: does console backup-HISTORY deletion pop identity re-verification? — see knowledge/validated-facts.md 2026-07-16 block.
